title: Maximum length of buildings
previewText: The outermost walls of each story of a building located entirely above a height of 95 feet shall be measured in plan view and inscribed within a rectangle. The maximum length of any side of such rectangle shall be 170 feet. For the purposes of this Section, abutting portions of buildings above a height of 95 feet shall be considered a single building.
